description: This file defines a syntax highlighting mode for the CodeMirror editor tailored to the Factor programming language. It specifies syntax rules, regex patterns for comments, strings, numbers, definitions, keywords, operators, and other language constructs to enable proper code highlighting within the editor.

methods.name: defineSimpleMode
methods.description: Defines a simple syntax highlighting mode named 'factor' with rules for various language constructs.

methods.name: defineMIME
methods.description: Associates the MIME type 'text/x-factor' with the 'factor' mode for proper recognition.
